title: Question-Guided Learning for Mathematics Education: An Autonomous Online Inquiry-Based Approach
summary: This paper presents an autonomous online application designed to support inquiry-based learning in mathematics when in-person instruction is not possible. The application teaches the concept of boundedness of functions through adaptive questioning, requiring active problem solving without teacher intervention. It was tested with 92 Hungarian secondary school students preparing for the advanced-level final examination.
